name: insuraviews
description: Search and analyze U.S. property and casualty insurance regulatory filings.

interface.longDescription: Search U.S. property and casualty insurance regulatory filings. Find rate, rule, and form filings by carrier, company, state, line of business, filing type, and date; count filing trends; review filing details and attachment text. Results link to the corresponding filing record in Insuraviews. Designed for insurance product, pricing, actuarial, compliance, and competitive-intelligence professionals. Information is for research and does not replace legal, actuarial, or regulatory advice.
defaultPrompt: Find Texas homeowners filings mentioning roof surfacing.
Compare recent Progressive personal auto filings in Texas.
How many homeowners filings were submitted in Texas in 2025?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

positive.description: Search filing text with state and line filters.
positive.prompt: Find Texas homeowners filings mentioning roof surfacing.
positive.expected_behavior: Search filing text for the phrase, apply the Texas and Homeowners filters, and return linked matches with supporting excerpts and dates. On the dataset dated 2026-10-30, the first result is MERY-133809777; explain that results are live and may change.

positive.description: Count filings for a defined period and filter set.
positive.prompt: How many Texas homeowners filings were submitted in 2025?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact total for Texas Homeowners filings with submitted dates from 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31, state the dataset date, and do not estimate by paging search results. The observed count for dataAsOf 2026-10-30 is 520.

positive.description: Resolve a carrier name, search its filings, and summarize the latest matching record.
positive.prompt: Find Progressive personal auto filings in Texas submitted in 2025 and summarize the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Progressive to Progressive Grp, search Texas Personal Auto filings in the 2025 submitted-date range, and retrieve the latest record. On the dataset dated 2026-10-30, the latest result is PRGS-134706593, submitted 2025-10-20, effective 2025-11-21, filed as Rate/Rule, with 0% rate impact. Link the filing and identify its Recreational Vehicle subline.

positive.description: Read structured details for a known filing.
positive.prompt: For MERY-133809777, give me the state, line of business, submission date, effective date, and disposition date.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the structured fields for Texas Homeowners, submitted 2023-12-18, effective 2024-05-24, and disposed 2024-04-02. Link the SERFF record and do not present the AI-written summary as verified document text.

positive.description: Read extracted text from an attachment using its key from the filing record.
positive.prompt: For MERY-133809777, use the filing attachment text to list the roof-surfacing form numbers shown on page 1.
positive.expected_behavior: Get the attachment key from the filing record, read page 1, and report the matching form numbers, including H0499 TX, H0500 TX, and H0700 when present. Cite the filing and do not claim access to the original PDF file.

negative.description: Submitting regulatory filings is unsupported; do not invoke tools or claim a filing was submitted.
negative.prompt: Submit this new rate filing to the Texas Department of Insurance for me.

negative.description: The plugin provides filing research, not a binding legal determination; do not invoke tools to answer as counsel.
negative.prompt: Tell me definitively whether this filing violates Texas insurance law and provide a legal opinion.

negative.description: The plugin does not quote or manage an individual's policy; do not invoke tools or request personal details.
negative.prompt: Using my home address and roof age, calculate my homeowners premium and change my coverage.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with Insuraviews MCP search, filing counts, filing details, and attachment-text lookup.
